about: SCION 18 Cartoon Saloon: every asset in the film. No found footage, doodles or model-generated images are used in the picture; the archive dog was looked at only as a gait/proportion reference.

assets.what: the dog's turnaround and expression sheet (L stand/crouch/lie, Q1 three-quarter rear, RV rear, Q1 lie; heads prof, back34, rear, front34, in34; legs and tail specs) and the person's two drawings
assets.source: written point by point for this film by the swarm (Claude, SCION 18)
assets.operation: drawn (coordinates authored as Catmull-Rom control points)

assets.what: cut-away house: patterned (triskele) wallpaper, wainscot, hearth, shelf with jug and bowls, rug, stool, door leaf, carved door frame, thatched roof, porch, post, railing, lattice skirt, steps; dusk sky, moon, hills, spiral-canopy trees
assets.source: drawn in code for this film
assets.operation: drawn (procedural ornament: spirals and triskeles are brush strokes computed from formulas)

assets.what: tapered brush-ribbon line and painted fill (pigment + wash + pooled edge)
paper grain, three watercolour washes, wood grain, granulation flecks
assets.source: synthesized from fixed seeds (numpy FFT noise)

assets.what: formant voice (Come here / It's all right / Come in), dusk wind and crickets, hearth crackle, door creak and knock, paw taps from the gait solver, thumps, sighs, tail thumps, plucked harp in D dorian
the PAELEO threshold score (dog x, choices, person circumstances, door, timeline)
assets.operation: read; the dog's x and the person's x/sit/reach/low drive the rig directly

assets.what: Big Shoulders Display, Literata (title and end cards)
